common.causal_rule: cause_event_ids may only reference lower seq events
common.identity_rule: event_id is stable within a trace and never reused
common.payload_rule: events carry policy-resolution facts only; never raw message/body payload
common.sensitive_value_rule: use trace_value ref/digest/redacted forms for private or sensitive values

tag_boundary.role: Tags are descriptive/routing projections over canonical state.
tag_boundary.replay_rule: A matched tag clause should record provenance to the canonical/tag projection source or be bound by selector_facts_digest.

selector_evaluated.purpose: Prove why one selector did or did not match.
selector_evaluated.replay_effect: Determines policy applicability only; never authority.
selector_evaluated.privacy: Observed selector facts may be inline only when safe; otherwise digest/ref/redact.

policy_matched.purpose: Declare that a policy revision entered the merge set.
policy_matched.replay_effect: Adds policy revision to current layer/branch merge set.

inheritance_step.purpose: Expose one edge of extends expansion or a cycle rejection.
inheritance_step.replay_effect: Controls which inherited policy operations become visible.

operation_evaluated.purpose: Record every policy operation, including rejected/no-op operations.
operation_evaluated.completeness: Exactly one per operation in every matched/effective inherited policy.

grant_evaluated.purpose: Prove whether an attempted authority widening was accepted.
grant_evaluated.replay_effect: May widen only when explicit grant rules pass.
grant_evaluated.forbidden_source: Tags/selectors alone can never authorize a grant.

deny_applied.purpose: Name the deny that dominated or defaulted a value.

lock_applied.replay_effect: Prevents later writes/grants on path or descendants.

stage_resolved.purpose: Checkpoint effective seven-gate state after one merge stage.
stage_resolved.replay_effect: Checkpoint only; must be derivable from prior events.

gate_final.purpose: Final proof for one of the seven gates.

resolution_final.replay_effect: Canonical terminal result; exactly one per trace.
